interpretation: Explicit reviewed IDs only. Client tables do not prove server proc rules, target eligibility, or spell availability. Remaining abilities are not certified by this snapshot.

Spell.Description_lang: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus $s2 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by $s1% for $d.
Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to $s2% of your Attack Power plus $s1 and increasing your movement speed by $s3% for $d.
Slam the target with your shield, causing $s2 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling $s1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
Instantly counterattack an enemy for $s1 damage and a high amount of threat.   Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.
The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by $s2% and causing $o1 Nature damage over $d.
Spell.AuraDescription_lang: Chance to hit with attacks decreased by $s2% and $s1 Nature damage every $t1 sec.

Spell.Description_lang: Blasts the target with energy, dealing $s1 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by $400573s1% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by $400573s2%. Effect stacks up to $400573u times and lasts $400573d or until any other damage spell is cast.
Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes $s1 Fire damage and an additional $o2 Fire damage over $d.
Deals $s1 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals $s2% increased damage to Frozen targets.
A word of darkness that causes $o1 Shadow damage over $d.
A word of dark binding that inflicts $s1 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to $s3% of your maximum health.
Afflicts the target with a disease that causes $o1 Shadow damage over $d.  Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.
Spell.AuraDescription_lang: Causes $s1 damage every $t1 seconds, healing the caster.

Spell.Description_lang: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for $s1 Nature damage.
Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing $s1 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Each jump reduces the damage by $?a415096[20%][30%].  Affects $x1 total targets.
You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing $s1 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals $s2% increased damage.
Instantly sears the target with fire, causing $s1 Fire damage immediately and $o2 Fire damage over $d.
Transfers $s1 health from the target to the caster every $t1 sec.  Lasts $d.
Spell.AuraDescription_lang: Drains $s1 health to the caster every $t1 secs.

Spell.Description_lang: Drains the soul of the target, causing $o2 Shadow damage over $d. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.
Deals $s1 Fire damage to your target and an additional $m2% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing $s1 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
Instantly blasts the target for $s2 Shadow damage.  If the target dies within $d of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.
Spell.AuraDescription_lang: Death will grant the Warlock a Soul Shard.

Spell.Description_lang: A powerful kick that deals $s2% melee weapon damage.

spell.Description_lang: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by $s1%.
Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by $m1%.
Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to $m1% of your Intellect.
Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a $m1% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by ${$m1/-1000}.2 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by $s1%.
Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by $m1%.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by $s1%.
Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by $s1.
Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by $m1%.
Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Increases your spell healing by up to $s2% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to $s1% of your total Spirit.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by $m2%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by $m1% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by $m2%.
Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by $s1%.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by $m1%.
Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by $/10;s1.

Increased the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by $s1%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by ${$m2/-1000} sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by ${$m3/1000} sec.
